summary.en: An illegal gold mine in southwest Colombia collapsed, killing 14 miners and injuring 7. The Colombian government is preparing a decree to define maritime boundaries for the San Andres, Providencia and Santa Catalina Archipelago while former rebel leaders face war crimes charges related to Indigenous groups. De la Espriella launched a total offensive against the ELN and dissident FARC forces in Arauca. The conflict recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Et ulovlig gullgruve i sørvestlige Colombia kollapset, og 14 gruvearbeidere ble drept mens 7 ble såret. Den colombianske regjeringen forbereder et dekret for å definere maritime grenser for øygruppen San Andres, Providencia og Santa Catalina, mens tidligere opprørsledere står overfor krigsforbryteranklager knyttet til urfolk. De la Espriella igangsatte en total offensiv mot ELN og dissidente FARC-styrker i Arauca. Konflikten registrerte 225 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
